_comment: Runtime profile for Codex (D30, D31, D37-RUNTIME-2). Interactive Codex sessions are not in the beta, so every step on Codex runs without a terminal through codex exec. A review step runs with the read-only sandbox and returns its verdict like any other runtime. Execution on Codex runs only where a flow names it, and stays experimental and untested until a comparison run gives the same result. Placeholders as in claude-code.json.
title: Codex
limits: The /status screen of an interactive Codex session shows the plan's usage limits; codex exec does not report them.
install: install Codex with: npm install -g @openai/codex, then log in with: codex login
